biotools.summary: Struc2mapGAN is a data-driven method utilizing generative adversarial networks to produce improved experimental-like density maps from molecular structures, outperforming existing simulation-based methods. The tool is publicly accessible via GitHub and accompanied by example usage and requirements files.
